description: This file defines classes and constants for ASN.1 data encoding/decoding, including Buffer, OID, and Sequence classes, with methods for handling ASN.1 data structures.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: Manages a byte buffer with reference counting and size management for ASN.1 encoding.

classes.name: OID
classes.description: Represents an Object Identifier with parsing and text conversion capabilities.

classes.name: Sequence
classes.description: Represents an ASN.1 sequence, providing methods for parsing ASN.1 encoded data.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Sets the size of the buffer.

methods.name: Size()
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer.

methods.name: Elements()
methods.description: Returns an iterator over ASN.1 elements.

methods.name: Text()
methods.description: Returns the textual representation of an OID.
